source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of degenerative disorders (PDF 51).

blocks.text: Yeh woh halatein hain jin mein dimagh, spinal cord ya peripheral nerves ke nerve cells ka zawal (deterioration) barhta jata hai. Misalein: Parkinson's disease (dimagh ke dopamine banane wale neurons ka barhta hua marna ya kamzor hona, jis se harkat ke masail aur soch mein tabdeeliyan aati hain), Huntington's disease (dimagh ke neurons ka barhta nuqsan, jis se harkat ki bimariyan, soch ka zawal aur nafsiyati alamaat aati hain), multiple sclerosis (CNS ki autoimmune bimari, yaani jism ka apna immune system hamla karta hai, jis mein myelin sheath kharab hoti hai aur nazar ka jana, dard, thakan aur kamzor coordination hota hai), aur Alzheimer's disease.
